name: Discourse comments (+)
description: Integrates a Discourse forum with Drupal: publishes nodes as Discourse topics, embeds their replies as comments, and lets visitors comment via Discourse SSO.
project_description: Discourse Comments (+) integrates a Drupal site with a Discourse discussion platform. When a node is first published with the "Push to Discourse" flag set, the module creates a matching Discourse topic through the Discourse REST API and stores the returned topic id/url/count on a per-node base field (discourse_plus_field). A block then fetches that topic's posts and renders them as comments underneath the node, and a second block lists the latest comments across topics. The (+) additions over the original discourse_comments module are: a DiscourseConnect (Discourse SSO) login flow so visitors can authenticate against Discourse and post replies directly from the Drupal page, per-content-type default categories with overrides, a token-driven footer template appended to each pushed post, optional separate internal/public Discourse base URLs (for reverse-proxied/dockerised Discourse), and a Drush command to warm the latest-comments cache. Configuration lives at /admin/config/discourse_comments_plus/discourse_comments_settings and requires the 'administer site configuration' permission.
